title: FocusedProfile
tagline: One platform to manage all your crypto profile information. Don't go to different places to update your info. Update once and distribute across all your crypto profiles.
description: One platform to manage all your crypto profile information. Don't go to different places to update your info. Update once and distribute across all your crypto profiles. Look up your crypto profile and address with ens domain name. Edit ens information. edit other contract information. Upload photo to IPFS and pin to storj to update your avatar. Future integrations to also manage lens profile.
how_its_made: Uses ENS for look up. Design is to implement IPFS for profile pic upload and Storj for pinning. I impressed myself because this was my first time using ethers and really building with web3 and I was able to do it alone with help and advice from people at ETH NY. Although I didn't get to implement everything i wanted i am excited to continue post eth ny to learn how to finish implementing the things I had trouble with.
